svg.aria-label: Clients reach seven Luna apps through a Cloudflare tunnel. Luna Unia, one home page, checks which Luna apps are running and opens each one with the shared sign-in. Six apps run a React UI and a FastMCP service; Luna Socia, the owner's chat with Luna, is one service. All share luna_sentia_network and rely on Luna Sentia for sign-on, PostgreSQL, Ollama and ComfyUI. Every model call goes through Sentia's model monitor, which times it, samples the GPU, keeps Socia's chat model qwen3:14b resident, and passes the call on to Ollama. Socia's pictures come from Qwen-Image 2.1 in ComfyUI, which takes turns with Ollama on the GPU. Visia's SigLIP 2, Vibia's CLAP and Lexia's Docling run inside those apps in processes that exit when idle. Luna Vibia tells Luna Lumia the mood and beats of the playing track.
